segments.ja476:1.1: Idheva haṃsa nipata, piyaṃ me tava dassanaṃ;
segments.ja476:2.1: Savanena ekassa piyā bhavanti, disvā panekassa viyeti [vineti (syā.), viheti (pī.), vigeti (ka. aṭṭha.)] chando;
segments.ja476:2.3: Disvā ca sutvā ca piyā bhavanti, kaccinnu me pīyasi [piyyasi (sī. pī.)] dassanena.
segments.ja476:3.1: Savanena piyo mesi, bhiyyo cāgamma dassanaṃ;
segments.ja476:3.3: Evaṃ piyadassano me [evaṃ piyadassano samāno (sī. syā. pī.)], vasa haṃsa mamantike [mama santike (sī. syā. pī.)].
segments.ja476:4.3: Matto ca ekadā vajje [vajjā (sī. pī.)],“haṃsarājaṃ pacantu me”.
segments.ja476:5.1: Dhiratthu taṃ majjapānaṃ, yaṃ me piyataraṃ tayā;
segments.ja476:5.3: Na cāpi majjaṃ pissāmi [pivissāmi (syā.), pāyāmi (sī. pī.)], yāva me vacchasī ghare.
segments.ja476:6.1: Suvijānaṃ siṅgālānaṃ, sakuṇānañca [sakuntānañca (sī. syā. pī.)] vassitaṃ;
segments.ja476:7.1: Api ce maññatī poso, ñāti mitto sakhāti vā;
segments.ja476:7.3: Yo pubbe sumano hutvā, pacchā sampajjate diso.
segments.ja476:8.1: Yasmiṃ mano nivisati, avidūre sahāpi so;
segments.ja476:8.3: Santikepi hi so dūre, yasmiṃ nāvisate [yasmā vivasate (sī. syā. pī.)] mano.
segments.ja476:9.1: Antopi so hoti pasannacitto, pāraṃ samuddassa pasannacitto;
segments.ja476:9.3: Antopi so hoti paduṭṭhacitto, pāraṃ samuddassa paduṭṭhacitto.
segments.ja476:10.1: Saṃvasantā vivasanti, ye disā te rathesabha;
segments.ja476:11.3: Āmanta kho taṃ gacchāma [gacchāmi (syā.)], purā te homa appiyā [homi appiyo (syā.)].
segments.ja476:12.3: Paricārakānaṃ sataṃ [santānaṃ (sī. syā.), sattānaṃ (pī.)], vacanaṃ na karosi no;
segments.ja476:12.5: Evaṃ taṃ abhiyācāma, puna kayirāsi pariyāyaṃ.
segments.ja476:13.1: Evaṃ ce no viharataṃ, antarāyo na hessati;
segments.ja476:13.3: Tuyhañcāpi [vāpi (syā. pī. ka.)] mahārāja, mayhañca [vā (bahūsu)] raṭṭhavaḍḍhana;
segments.ja476:13.5: Appeva nāma passemu [passema (sī. syā. pī.)], ahoratānamaccayeti.
